operations.description: Modifies a component. Any fields included in the request are overwritten. If leadUserName is an empty string ("") the component lead is removed. Permissions required: Any of the following:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] component [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 6 body

operations.description: Selects a time tracking provider.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] configuration timetracking [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the time tracking settings.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] configuration timetracking options [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the value of a dashboard item property. Use this resource in apps to store custom data against a dashboard item.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] dashboard items properties [PARAMS] dashboard id item key property [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates an option for a select list issue field. If the option does not exist, a new option is created.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] field option [PARAMS] field id key option [SCHEMA] body

operations.description: Sets the default sharing for new filters and dashboards for a user. Permissions required: Permission to log in to Jira (i.e., member of the users group).
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] filter default share scope [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates an existing filter. Use this method to update a filter's name, description, JQL, or sharing. Permissions required: Permission to log in to Jira, however the following rules govern what a user can update:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] filter [PARAMS] expand id [SCHEMA] 7 body

operations.description: Sets the columns for a filter. Only navigable fields can be set as columns. Use Get fields to get the list fields in Jira. A navigable field has navigable set to true. Permissions required: Permission to log in to Jira (i.e., member of the users group) and permission to view the filter.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] filter columns [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Add a filter as a favorite for the calling user. Permissions required: Permission to log in to Jira (i.e., member of the users group) and permission to view the filter.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] filter favourite [PARAMS] expand id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets a property value on multiple issues. The issues to be updated can be specified by a filter.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue properties [PARAMS] key property [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Edits an issue. A transition may be applied and issue properties updated as part of the edit.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue [PARAMS] editable flag id issue key notify or override screen security users [SCHEMA] 8 body

operations.description: Assigns an issue to a user. Use this operation when the calling user does not have the Edit Issues permission but has the Assign issue permission for the project that the issue is in.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue assignee [PARAMS] id issue key or [SCHEMA]

operations.description: a string containing the issue id or key the comment belongs to
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue comment [PARAMS] expand id issue key or [SCHEMA] 10 body

operations.description: Sets the value of an issue's property. Use this resource to store custom data against an issue.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue properties [PARAMS] id issue key or property [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates a remote issue link for an issue.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue remotelink [PARAMS] id issue key link or [SCHEMA] 11 body

operations.description: Updates a worklog.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue worklog [PARAMS] adjust editable estimate expand flag id issue key new notify or override users [SCHEMA] 3 body

operations.description: Sets the value of a worklog property. Use this operation to store custom data against the worklog.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue worklog properties [PARAMS] id issue key or property worklog [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates an issue link type.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issue link type [PARAMS] id issue link type [SCHEMA] 12 body

operations.description: Updates the issue type. Permissions required: Administer Jira global permission.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issuetype [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Creates or updates the value of the issue type property. Use this resource to store and update data against an issue type. The value of the request body must be a valid, non-empty JSON blob. The maximum length of the property value is 32768 bytes. Permissions required: Administer Jira global permission.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] issuetype properties [PARAMS] id issue key property type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Creates a preference for the user or updates its value. An arbitrary preference can be created with the value containing up to 255 characters. In addition, the following keys define system preferences that can be set or created:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] mypreferences [PARAMS] key [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the locale of the current user. The requested locale must be one supported by the instance of Jira.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] mypreferences locale [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates a permission scheme. Below are some important things to note when using this resource:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] permissionscheme [PARAMS] expand id scheme [SCHEMA] 13 body

operations.description: Updates the project details of an existing project.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project [PARAMS] expand id key or project [SCHEMA] 14 body

operations.description: Sets the avatar displayed for a project.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project avatar [PARAMS] id key or project [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the value of the project property. You can use project properties to store custom data against the project.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project properties [PARAMS] id key or project property [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Associates actors with the project role for the project, replacing all existing actors.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project role [PARAMS] id key or project [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates the project type.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project type [PARAMS] id key new or project type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Associates a permission scheme with a particular project. See Managing project permissions for more information about permission schemes.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project permissionscheme [PARAMS] expand id key or project [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates a project category.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] project category [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 2 body

operations.description: Update the project role's name and description. You must include both a name and a description in the request.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] role [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 15 body

operations.description: Updates the name of a screen tab.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] screens tabs [PARAMS] id screen tab [SCHEMA] 16 body

operations.description: Sets the default issue navigator columns.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] settings columns [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the default issue table columns for the user. If a username is not passed, the calling user's default columns are set. If no column details are sent, then all default columns are removed. The parameters for this resource are expressed as HTML form data. For example, in curl: curl -X PUT -d username=<username> -d columns=summary -d columns=description <url> Permissions required:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] user columns [PARAMS] account id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the value of a user's property. Use this resource to store custom data against a user. Permissions required:
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] user properties [PARAMS] account id key property user username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Modifies a project version. Permissions required: Administer Jira global permission or Administer Projects project permission.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] version [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 17 body

operations.description: Merges two project versions. The merge is completed by deleting the version specified in id and replacing any occurrences of its ID in fixVersion with the version ID specified in moveIssuesTo. Consider using Delete and replace version instead. This resource supports swapping version values in fixVersion, affectedVersion, and custom fields. Permissions required: Administer Jira global permission or Administer Projects project permission.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] version mergeto [PARAMS] id issues move to [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates a workflow transition by changing the property value. Trying to update a property that does not exist results in a new property being added to the transition. Transition properties are used to change the behavior of a transition. For more information, see Transition properties and Workflow properties.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflow transitions properties [PARAMS] id key mode name transition workflow [SCHEMA] 18 body

operations.description: Updates a workflow scheme, including the name, default workflow, issue type to project mappings, and more. If the workflow scheme is active (that is, being used by at least one project), then a draft workflow scheme is created or updated instead, provided that updateDraftIfNeeded is set to true.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 19 body

operations.description: Sets the default workflow for a workflow scheme.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme default [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 4 body

operations.description: Updates a draft workflow scheme. If a draft workflow scheme does not exist for the active workflow scheme, then a draft is created. Note that an active workflow scheme can only have one draft workflow scheme at any given time.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme draft [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 19 body

operations.description: Sets the default workflow for a workflow scheme's draft.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme draft default [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] 4 body

operations.description: Sets the workflow for an issue type in a workflow scheme's draft.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme draft issuetype [PARAMS] id issue type [SCHEMA] 9 body

operations.description: Sets the issue types for a workflow in a workflow scheme's draft. The workflow can also be set as the default workflow for the draft workflow scheme. Unmapped issues types are mapped to the default workflow.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme draft workflow [PARAMS] id name workflow [SCHEMA] 5 body

operations.description: Sets the workflow for an issue type in a workflow scheme.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme issuetype [PARAMS] id issue type [SCHEMA] 9 body

operations.description: Sets the issue types for a workflow in a workflow scheme. The workflow can also be set as the default workflow for the workflow scheme. Unmapped issues types are mapped to the default workflow.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] workflowscheme workflow [PARAMS] id name workflow [SCHEMA] 5 body
